q: Fibre optics works on the principle of total internal _____.
e: Fibre optics sends information as light pulses in a glass or plastic core, held by total internal reflection at the core-cladding boundary. Incidence must exceed the critical angle. An echo is reflection, not refraction.

q: An optical fibre is composed of two concentric layers called the core and the _____.
e: Cladding surrounds the core and provides the lower refractive index for total internal reflection. The protective jacket is outside the cladding, not the other way round. Light is meant to stay in the core. Incidence must exceed the critical angle or light leaks.
